reminder.text: When your Initiative Count begins, take an extra firearm or heavy-weapon final attack at –2 to all checks for the round.

Hurled weapons are drawn freely and always readied, can Burst, Cover Fire and Suppressive Fire, and are easier to stash.
Club foes with a readied shotgun, fire it one-handed at –2, raise its save DCs by 4, and knock targets back 5 ft. on a hit.
When your Initiative Count begins, take an extra unarmed final attack at –2 to all checks for the round.
Halved visual-range Notice penalty, better gliding, and air vehicles treat maneuvering room as wider with +2 on Crisis Advantage checks.
Stunts are easier (–5 DC, –1 error), vehicle jumps go 50% farther, and your vehicle takes half falling damage.
Your Cheap Shots on vulnerable foes impose an extra –1 penalty or –5 ft. Speed.
Once per round, Coup de Grace a helpless character as a half action.
Halved Stealth penalties for moving or speaking, no Disposition tag, and you're invisible in crowds of 500+.
No Stealth penalties for moving or speaking, smaller team/terrain penalties, and invisible in crowds of 50+.
No penalties while climbing (including without a kit), foes get no bonus against climbing you, and Initiative bonus when combat starts on a wall.
Climb faster, catch yourself on most surfaces when falling, and take less falling damage.
Climb at full Speed, don't need extra checks when hurt while climbing, and climbing with a kit is easier.
Treat codes as 2 Power Rating lower when breaking, writing or requesting them.
